Step 3: Develop expertise in designing and analyzing growth experiments, communicating data-driven insights, and influencing product strategy for user acquisition, activation, and retention.

projects.title: User Onboarding Funnel Analysis (SQL & Looker Studio)
projects.description: Created a detailed onboarding funnel analysis for a SaaS product using SQL to extract user event data and visualized drop-off points in Looker Studio to identify areas for improvement.

projects.title: A/B Test Results Analyzer with Statistical Significance (Python/Jupyter Notebook)
projects.description: Developed a Python-based Jupyter Notebook to automatically analyze A/B test results, calculate statistical significance (p-value), and interpret confidence intervals for key metrics.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction Model (Python Scikit-learn & SQL)
projects.description: Built a predictive model using Python's Scikit-learn library to forecast potential customer churn based on historical user behavior data extracted via SQL queries from a data warehouse.

projects.title: Cohort Analysis for User Retention (SQL, Pandas & Matplotlib)
projects.description: Performed a cohort analysis on a user base to understand long-term retention trends, using SQL for data extraction and Python (Pandas, Matplotlib) for visualization and trend identification.

projects.title: Feature Adoption Rate Dashboard (Mixpanel & Tableau)
projects.description: Designed an interactive Tableau dashboard showcasing the adoption rates and engagement metrics for new product features, leveraging event data from Mixpanel.

projects.title: Experimentation Design & Readout for a New Product Feature (Documentation & Mockup Analysis)
projects.description: Documented the full lifecycle of an A/B experiment for a new feature, including hypothesis, experimental design, metric definition, and a mock readout of expected results and recommendations.
